policy: One combined TASM1/2 Red kit; Overclock, Dragnet and Vortex are its final added skills. Hunter revision 3 is authoritative with later player overrides: player-liked Down+A Web Yank and v0.35.0 Sky Rake ship alongside the taller cape-free appearance, Hunter's Return and manual-jump Talon Lift. combat_design.request: Make Black play and fight as close as possible to Miguel O'Hara in Across the Spider-Verse; make it fun. Revision 1 review: avoid one-trick pinning, answer bosses, add webbing and air combos, add rows as needed within the 2D mob/boss brawler. Revision 2 review: X for webs approved; remove Collar Toss and Lariat; add one skill that rewards a full combo meter like Red's Momentum/Overclock.

suits.validation_limit: See sky_rake.json: 655 full-suite tests, seven focused tests, twenty copied-save controls and exact source/canonical/publisher/stable identity. Real shop/save/fresh Continue preserve progress. A chapter kill uses one initial low-HP fixture; natural Conductor rakes and a labelled finisher action/node probe establish heavy stagger, not a full standing-boss air combo. Web Yank input/feel is player-liked; Sky Rake feel, full-route economy, perceptual audio and hardware pacing remain open. Native mini-boss targeting/Boarding adapters remain pending.
